[{"type": "text", "text": "Mathlib/MeasureTheory/VectorMeasure/Variation/Basic.lean  (lines 1–50 of 444):
     1  /-
     2  Copyright (c) 2025 Oliver Butterley. All rights reserved.
     3  Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
     4  Authors: Oliver Butterley, Yoh Tanimoto
     5  -/
     6  module
     7  
     8  public import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Module.Basic
     9  public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Measure.Dirac
    10  public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.VectorMeasure.Variation.Defs
    11  
    12  /-!
    13  # Properties of variation
    14  
    15  We prove basic properties of `variation` for `μ : VectorMeasure X V` in `ENormedAddCommMonoid V` on
    16  `MeasurableSpace X`. It is defined as the supremum over partitions `{Eᵢ}` of `E`, of the quantity
    17  `∑ᵢ, ‖μ(Eᵢ)‖`. This definition allows one to define the integral against
    18  such vector-valued measures.
    19  
    20  ## Main results
    21  
    22  * `enorm_measure_le_variation`: `‖μ E‖ₑ ≤ variation μ E`.
    23  * `variation_zero`: `(0 : VectorMeasure X V).variation = 0`.
    24  * `variation_neg`: `(-μ).variation = μ.variation`.
    25  * `absolutelyContinuous`: `μ ≪ᵥ μ.variation`.
    26  * `ennrealVariation_eq_self`: if `μ : VectorMeasure X ℝ≥0∞` then `μ.ennrealVariation = μ`.
    27  
    28  ## References
    29  
    30  * [Walter Rudin, Real and Complex Analysis.][Rud87]
    31  
    32  -/
    33  
    34  public section
    35  
    36  open Finset Set
    37  open scoped ENNReal NNReal
    38  
    39  namespace MeasureTheory.VectorMeasure
    40  
    41  variable {X V : Type*} {mX : MeasurableSpace X}
    42  
    43  /-- The sum of a vector measure `μ` on a `Finpartition` of `Subtype MeasurableSet` equals `μ s`. -/
    44  lemma sum_finpartition [AddCommMonoid V] [TopologicalSpace V] [T2Space V]
    45      (μ : VectorMeasure X V) {s : Set X} {hs : MeasurableSet s}
    46      (P : Finpartition (⟨s, hs⟩ : Subtype MeasurableSet)) : ∑ p ∈ P.parts, μ p.val = μ s := by
    47    rw [← μ.of_biUnion_finset (P.pairwiseDisjoint_apply (fun _ _ => rfl) rfl) (fun p _ => p.prop),
    48        ← Finset.sup_set_eq_biUnion, P.sup_parts_apply (fun _ _ => rfl) rfl]
    49  
    50  section Basic
"}]
